- Experience with platform strategies in energy transition sectors
- Corporate finance or project finance transaction experience (from origination to execution)
- Relevant experience and knowledge of power/energy industry required
- Fluent English required with additional European languages preferred
- International deal experience
- Candidates must have the right to work in the UK
- Demonstrable network of contacts among the universe of project sponsors
- A strong academic background appropriate to the role, however a variety of backgrounds are welcome from: finance, engineering, accounting, legal, or the STEM fields.

- Excellent communication and written skills

Nuveen is the investment management arm of TIAA. It is one of the largest global asset managers with specialist knowledge across a wide array of asset classes, including fixed income, equities and alternatives. Nuveen is driven not only by the independent investment processes across the firm, but also the insights, risk management, analytics and other tools and resources a truly world-class platform provides. As a global asset manager, our mission is to work in partnership with our clients to create outcome-focused solutions to help them secure their financial future. For more information about the firm please visit our website at www.Nuveen.com

Overview of the Role:
The South Korea Investment Manager  will be the ultimate responsible for the origination, acquisition and divestment execution, and financing of renewable energy assets, including solar PV, onshore and offshore wind, battery storage, and renewable energy development platforms in South Korea.  They will oversee all activities and act as the central contact point for internal and external stakeholders when it comes to renewable energy investments and divestments in South Korea. The ideal candidate must have direct experience in originating and executing renewable energy transaction in South Korea.
The role offers potential for an attractive career path in clean energy as further funds with international and local mandates will be rolled out in coming years.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Conduct market and competition analysis and establish strategy for the deployment of capital in renewable energy investments in solar, wind (on and off-shore) and storage in South Korea.
- Manage the origination and execution of South Korean clean energy investments (acquisitions, mergers, project finance and divestures) in projects, joint ventures and development platforms leading a small internal team, and external advisors.
- Oversee the production of financial models for renewable energy generation projects/assets.
- Supervise preparation of and defend investments proposals in the Investment Committee.
- Network and manage relationships with South Korean co-investors – investments may range from minority stakes alongside local investor to 100% owned deals.
- Manage working relationships with external advisors (developers, lawyers, technical advisors, debt providers, EPC contractors, etc) in South Korea.
- Attract third party debt funding and Lead negotiation of key economic aspect of investments with counterparties (lending banks, EPC, developers etc.).
- Oversee the operations of development platforms acquired or established by Nuveen.
- Ensure the efficient delivery of projects in development and construction using past experience in EPC, bank documentation preparation, legal documentation.
- Act as Board Member or Director of investee companies, monitor and review of the investments in the portfolio in South Korea.
- Management accounts of portfolio’s assets.
- Support in liaising with renewable energy organisations, NGOs, utility companies and local authorities, etc

Experience in leading and directing small teams of investment professionals and asset managers.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst II - Registered
jobs.description:
Treasury Analyst II - FINRA
The Treasury Analyst II Registered supports the cash management and liquidity strategy of the enterprise by performing treasury activities in an accurate and timely manner. Working independently under general supervision, this job performs and reviews cash flow monitoring and reporting as well as financial transaction and status reporting. This job also supports the financial risk management department in the collection, validation and maintenance of data needed to perform financial analysis as required by corporate policies.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - Analyzes and interprets financial data, modeling forward-looking cash flows, and developing cash management, investment, and risk mitigation strategies that support execution of the company’s liquidity management strategy and stress testing process.

- Compiles, analyzes and presents data to help Treasurer and management team understand implications of current economic environment to ongoing treasury operations.

- Manages daily flow of funds and transactions (e.g., daily cash requirements, cash receipts and payments, financial obligations, debt covenants, investment closings, etc.) to execute the company’s global cash management strategy.
